comments.body: Also, there's a World Clock XVI second period limited time recipe for the Improved Rope item in Venice! The sewing rank is still eight, but you need 15 jute, and 30 sisal. Look for the Adventurer NPC by the water's edge, just a little south of the Doge's Palace!
